enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website content is detailed and confirms most OSM fields directly. The RV Rentals page confirms small green propane canisters are stocked in the camp store, and the front page and on-site activities page confirm covered shelter in the renovated games/washroom building.
concerns: Name discrepancy: OSM records 'Canyon Alpine RV Park & Campground' but website consistently uses 'Canyon Alpine RV RESORT & Campground'.
